name: Hu tieu sa te
summary: The satay version of Mỹ Tho’s rice-noodle bowl, made from the same Mỹ Phong strands and eaten beside the soup and dry bowls.
origin: Mỹ Tho, from the noodle craft of Mỹ Phong.
howToEat: Order it as the satay alternative to the soup and dry bowls of hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho.
where: The noodle craft is in Mỹ Phong and the neighboring wards of Mỹ Tho.
seoTitle: Hu tieu sa te in My Tho
seoDescription: Hủ tiếu sa tế, the satay bowl of Mỹ Tho rice noodles, eaten beside the soup and dry versions.
